$schema: none — plain data consumed only by tests/booking-copy-drift.test.js
$purpose: Canonical PRESENTATION COPY for the booking surface.
This file is NOT loaded at runtime and is NOT a source of business authority.
It carries no price, no total, no fee, no booking state, no payment state and
no confirmation semantics. Pricing authority stays in the catalog/server,
payment authority stays in the Postgres ledger, booking state stays in the
Blob CAS store. Nothing here may be imported by page or function code.
Its only job is to stop the same customer-facing sentence from drifting into
13 different versions across the authoritative page and its compatibility

surfaces.$note: compatibility surfaces hide their inline modal behind assets/hub-booking-bridge.js and iframe the authoritative page; the copy must still match because the inline DOM is the degradation path.

required.why: Neutral title. The earlier 'Lock Your Slot' promised a reservation the system does not make.

required.text: A card on file is still required to submit the booking request.
required.why: States what the card enables (submitting a request), not what it reserves.

required.text: No charge today. Your card is securely saved by Stripe and may only be charged according to our cancellation, no-show, access, or approved service payment policy.
required.why: Custody + the exhaustive list of what can trigger a charge.
The card is mandatory for every payment preference; the label must not imply it is optional.

required.text: Before saving your card, please note:
I have read and agree to the booking, cancellation, no-show, access, and card-on-file policy.
required.why: The consent sentence recorded against the booking. Changing it changes what customers agreed to.
The confirm step must label the charged-today row as a request, not a payment. The amount itself is rendered by the page, never stored here.
Request terminology at the moment of submission.

required.text: PCI-secure · no raw card data stored
required.why: Custody claim; must stay true and identical everywhere.

required.text: We bring our own water and power
required.why: Resolves the contradiction between the marketing promise and the access questions.
The field is genuinely optional; the label must say so.
Arrival-window wording feeds the operational slot resolver.
The window length must match BK_ARRIVAL_BOUNDS.

required.text: Next available appointments are typically 3 days out.
required.why: Must equal MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS in netlify/lib/operational-availability.js. tests/conversion-funnel-copy.test.js pins the number to the constant; this entry pins the sentence across surfaces.
Step 5 label. 'Secure' means made safe, not reserved — the surrounding copy carries the request semantics.
